events.label: Outburst flood (GLOF)
events.detail: Moraine-dammed lake breached on the night of 3-4 Oct 2023; the flood travelled down the Teesta valley and destroyed the Chungthang dam.

source: Sentinel-2 L2A (ESA Copernicus) via AWS Earth Search STAC, COGs on AWS Open Data

method.water: NDWI > 0.1 and NIR <= 0.2, SCL cloud mask
method.ice: NDSI > 0.4 and NIR >= 0.11 (snow and clean ice; debris-covered ice not detected)
